shortDescription: NetApp ONTAP vserver CIFS security modification

options.name: cert_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client cert file (.pem). not supported with python 2.6.

options.name: encryption_required_for_dc_connections
options.description: Specifies whether encryption is required for domain controller connections.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ONTAP instance.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Override the default port (80 or 443) with this port

options.name: https
options.description: Enable and disable https. Ignored when using REST as only https is supported. Ignored when using SSL certificate authentication as it requires SSL.

options.name: is_aes_encryption_enabled
options.description: Determine whether AES-128 and AES-256 encryption mechanisms are enabled for Kerberos-related CIFS communication.

options.name: is_password_complexity_required
options.description: Determine whether password complexity is required for local users.

options.name: is_signing_required
options.description: Determine whether signing is required for incoming CIFS traffic.

options.name: is_smb_encryption_required
options.description: Determine whether SMB encryption is required for incoming CIFS traffic.

options.name: kerberos_clock_skew
options.description: The clock skew in minutes is the tolerance for accepting tickets with time stamps that do not exactly match the host's system clock.

options.name: kerberos_kdc_timeout
options.description: Determine the timeout value in seconds for KDC connections.

options.name: kerberos_renew_age
options.description: Determine the maximum amount of time in days for which a ticket can be renewed.

options.name: kerberos_ticket_age
options.description: Determine the maximum amount of time in hours that a user's ticket may be used for the purpose of Kerberos authentication.

options.name: key_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client key file.

options.name: lm_compatibility_level
options.description: Determine the LM compatibility level.

options.name: ontapi
options.description: The ontap api version to use

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the specified user.

options.name: referral_enabled_for_ad_ldap
options.description: Determine whether LDAP referral chasing is enabled or not for AD LDAP connections.

options.name: session_security_for_ad_ldap
options.description: Determine the level of security required for LDAP communications.

options.name: smb1_enabled_for_dc_connections
options.description: Determine if SMB version 1 is used for connections to domain controllers.

options.name: smb2_enabled_for_dc_connections
options.description: Determine if SMB version 2 is used for connections to domain controllers.

options.name: use_ldaps_for_ad_ldap
options.description: Determine whether to use LDAPS for secure Active Directory LDAP connections.

options.name: use_rest
options.description: This module only supports ZAPI and can not be swtiched to REST. never -- will always use ZAPI if the module supports ZAPI.  An error may be issued if a REST option is not supported in ZAPI. auto -- will always use ZAPI.

options.name: use_start_tls_for_ad_ldap
options.displayName: Use Start Tls For Ad Ldap
options.description: Determine whether to use start_tls for AD LDAP connections.

options.name: username
options.description: This can be a Cluster-scoped or SVM-scoped account, depending on whether a Cluster-level or SVM-level API is required. For more information, please read the documentation U(https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap/authentication/create-svm-user-accounts-task.html). Two authentication methods are supported 1. options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(False) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vserver
options.description: name of the vserver.
